name: Humanoid robot key component stack
description: A commercial humanoid robot platform component stack for early fleet deployment: actuators, hands, battery and power, thermal management, sensing, onboard compute, control software, structure, safety, manufacturing, and service. This is a paid-domain candidate map, not a reviewed investment product.

targetContext.targetScale: pilot fleets to early 10k-unit/year manufacturing programs
targetContext.targetPerformance: human-scale biped mobility, useful manipulation, safe operation around people, multi-hour duty cycle
targetContext.targetUseCase: industrial, logistics, and service tasks in human-designed spaces
targetContext.region: US users researching global suppliers and listed exposure

name: Human-form-factor workforce automation capability
description: The demand-side capability: robots that can use human-centric spaces, tools, and task flows without redesigning every workplace.

name: Actuation system
description: Joint modules, reducers, motors, bearings, encoders, and drive electronics. It bottlenecks payload, walking stability, duty cycle, noise, and service life.

metrics.name: Humanoid actuation subsystem cost magnitude
metrics.description: V0 order-of-magnitude estimate for the full actuation subsystem, anchored to public low-end humanoid robot price and 23-43 joint motor disclosure. Not a confirmed BOM.

name: Dexterous hand and tactile system
description: Hand mechanisms, finger actuation, tactile arrays, slip detection, and local hand control. It determines whether the robot can do useful manipulation rather than only locomotion demos.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: Public humanoid sources do not break out hand mechanics, tactile sensors, local control, reliability qualification, and integration as a reviewed component price.

name: Battery, power, and charging system
description: Cell selection, pack architecture, BMS, power distribution, docking, and certification. It gates runtime, fleet uptime, abuse tolerance, and deployability.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: Reviewed public humanoid sources identify battery/runtime and charging constraints, but do not break out pack, BMS, docking, certification, and fleet-spares cost as a standalone audited subsystem price.

name: Thermal management system
description: Thermal paths for motors, drives, battery, and edge compute. Poor thermal design shortens useful duty cycle and turns demos into short bursts.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: Reviewed public sources support thermal constraints around motors, batteries, and compute, but not a standalone humanoid thermal BOM, qualification, and service cost.

name: Perception and sensing stack
description: Cameras, depth, LiDAR, IMU, encoders, force/torque, tactile, proximity, and audio sensing. Sensor alignment and drift become control errors at the body level.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: Public sources list sensing and perception ingredients, but not the audited cost of sensor fusion, calibration, drift control, and replacement for a commercial humanoid fleet.

name: Onboard compute and control electronics
description: Edge AI compute, real-time controllers, motor-control networking, power isolation, and safety electronics. It must fit autonomy into a tight power and heat envelope.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: Reviewed public sources support onboard compute and controller roles, but not a separated controller, safety electronics, networking, and power-isolation cost for humanoid production.

name: Structure, materials, and harness
description: Skeleton, enclosures, skin, cable routing, connectors, feet, and serviceable modules. Weight, stiffness, wire fatigue, and assembly tolerance decide real fleet reliability.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: Reviewed sources support structure, battery, safety, and certification roles, but not an audited structure, harness, connector, enclosure, and serviceability cost as a separate subsystem.

name: Locomotion and whole-body control software
description: Whole-body control, balance, gait, state estimation, contact control, fall recovery, and runtime safety monitoring.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: No reviewed public source prices whole-body control, balance, fall recovery, field validation, and runtime safety monitoring separately from the full humanoid program.

name: Manipulation AI and data stack
description: Vision-language-action policies, grasp planning, teleoperation data, imitation/RL training, task planning, and fleet learning.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: No reviewed public source breaks out manipulation policy, teleoperation data, simulation, fleet learning, and validation cost from the complete humanoid robot program.

name: Manufacturing, test, safety, and service
description: Assembly, calibration, burn-in, traceability, functional safety, E-stop, duty-cycle validation, field service, and spares loops.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: No reviewed public source prices the combined assembly, calibration, burn-in, traceability, functional-safety, field-service, and spares loop per humanoid robot.

name: Rotary joint module
description: Torque-dense rotary joint for shoulders, hips, wrists, and ankles. It gates useful payload because motor, reducer, bearing, encoder, drive, heat path, and harness must fit inside one serviceable joint.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: Public humanoid sources do not break out rotary joint BOM, yield, burn-in, service spares, and actuator-level qualification as an audited module price.

name: Linear joint module
description: High-force linear actuator path for legs, knees, torso, or high-load axes. It is hard to clear because screw life, shock loads, lubrication, sealing, and compact packaging all affect field reliability.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: No reviewed public source prices humanoid linear actuator assemblies, fatigue validation, sealing, lubrication, and field-replacement cost separately.

name: Reducer and transmission stack
description: Strain-wave, planetary, cycloidal, or screw transmission choices that set backlash, stiffness, torque density, and lifetime. The bottleneck is not only precision; it is repeatable joint-grade quality, lifecycle validation, and enough qualified suppliers for humanoid-scale actuator volumes.

metrics.name: Humanoid reducer and transmission stack cost magnitude
metrics.description: V0 order-of-magnitude estimate for multiple precision reducer/transmission elements across a humanoid actuation stack. Not a confirmed BOM or supplier quote.

name: Motor stack
description: Frameless BLDC, direct-drive, or quasi-direct-drive motors sized for compact torque and heat rejection. Motor choice gates noise, duty cycle, efficiency, magnet exposure, and actuator thermal headroom.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: Public sources support humanoid motor and joint counts, but do not disclose audited motor-stack BOM, magnet sourcing, winding yield, thermal margin, or service-spares cost.

name: Motor drive power electronics
description: Gate drivers, current sensing, inverter power stage, protection, EMI filtering, and control loops for many distributed joints.

name: Joint sensing and feedback
description: Absolute encoders, torque sensing, current sensing, temperature sensing, and calibration model for closed-loop force and position control.

name: Joint bearings and sealing
description: Thin-section bearings, cross-roller bearings, seals, lubrication, and shock handling inside compact joints. It gates fleet reliability because impact, dust, wire motion, and maintenance access turn commodity bearings into joint-specific qualification work.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: No reviewed public source breaks out humanoid joint bearing, sealing, lubrication, shock qualification, and replacement-rate cost as a standalone subsystem.

name: Strain-wave reducer
description: Compact high-ratio reducer option with low backlash but lifetime and cost pressure at humanoid volumes.

name: Planetary roller screw
description: High-force linear conversion component whose precision thread grinding and fatigue life can become high-load actuator bottlenecks.

name: Frameless BLDC torque motor
description: Compact permanent-magnet motor integrated into joint housings.

name: Rare-earth magnet supply
description: NdFeB-class magnet supply that affects compact motors and geopolitical supply risk.

name: Joint inverter power stage
description: MOSFET/GaN power stage sized for compact multi-axis joint current control.

name: Current sensing and gate driver
description: High-bandwidth current sensing and gate drive electronics required for stable torque control and protection.

name: EMI filtering and grounding
description: Distributed motor-drive EMI control across dense wiring and sensors.

name: Five-finger hand mechanism
description: Multi-DoF hand mechanism for object handling, tool use, and human-like workspace compatibility. It gates usefulness because finger packaging, actuation, tactile routing, breakage, and replacement cost decide whether manipulation survives outside demos.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: Public humanoid sources do not disclose an audited five-finger hand BOM, actuator count, tactile integration, field breakage, or spare-hand cost.

name: Tendon or cable hand transmission
description: Remote-drive hand transmission that saves finger volume but adds routing, stretch, friction, and calibration issues.

name: Micro hand actuator
description: Small motor, gearbox, leadscrew, or tendon drive packaged in the hand and wrist volume.

name: Fingertip tactile array
description: Dense pressure/shear sensing at the fingertip for slip detection and grasp control.

name: Palm force and tactile array
description: Palm contact sensing for stable large-object manipulation and safe human interaction.

name: Slip detection policy
description: Control method converting tactile streams into grip adjustments before objects fall.

name: Lithium-ion cell selection
description: Cell chemistry and format trade-off across energy density, discharge power, safety, and cycle life.

name: Battery pack enclosure and interconnect
description: Mechanical pack, interconnect, fuse, contactor, sealing, and abuse protection for a moving robot body. It gates runtime and safety because pack packaging must absorb falls, thermal events, high-current transients, and fast service swaps.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: Reviewed sources support battery/runtime constraints, but not an audited humanoid pack enclosure, interconnect, protection, certification, and replacement cost.

name: Battery management system
description: Cell monitoring, balancing, state estimation, protection, diagnostics, and certification interface.

name: High-current power distribution bus
description: Distributed high-current power routing, conversion, protection, and isolation between pack, compute, and joints.

name: Charging and docking interface
description: Fleet charging dock, contact alignment, battery swap or charging control, and service ergonomics. It gates uptime because robots that cannot self-dock, charge safely, and return to service create hidden operator labor.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: No reviewed public source prices humanoid charging docks, automatic alignment, connector life, battery-swap workflow, or fleet charger deployment cost.

name: Battery pack safety certification
description: UN38.3, UL-class, transport, abuse, and functional safety requirements for mobile robot batteries.

name: Motor and joint thermal path
description: Heat conduction from winding, drive, gearbox, and bearing stack to housing without creating touch-temperature or reliability issues.

name: Battery thermal safety
description: Cell temperature monitoring, heat spreading, runaway containment, and pack-level shutoff.

name: Compute heat spreader
description: Thermal interface, heat spreader, and sink path for edge AI modules inside torso/head volume.

name: Airflow or liquid cooling loop
description: Fan, duct, heat-pipe, cold plate, or liquid loop design constrained by noise, dust, impact, and service. It gates sustained work because motors, drives, battery, and edge compute create heat in a sealed moving body.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: Reviewed sources support humanoid thermal constraints, but not an audited airflow, heat-pipe, cold-plate, liquid-loop, acoustic, and service cost.

name: Thermal sensor map
description: Thermistors and IC temperature sensors across pack, motors, drivers, compute, and enclosure hot spots.

name: Sustained duty-cycle validation
description: Thermal and reliability test process proving a robot can work useful shifts, not only short demos.

name: Stereo RGB camera module
description: Head or torso cameras for perception, teleoperation, and scene understanding.

name: Depth camera and 3D LiDAR
description: Depth sensing for navigation, obstacle avoidance, and manipulation workspace estimation.

name: IMU attitude sensing
description: Inertial sensing for balance, state estimation, impact detection, and fall recovery.

name: Joint encoder and position sensing
description: Absolute or incremental joint feedback needed for stable body control and calibration.

name: Force and torque sensing
description: Foot, wrist, and joint force sensing for contact-aware locomotion and manipulation.

name: Proximity and touch safety sensing
description: Close-range detection and contact sensing for human-robot interaction and collision mitigation.

name: Audio and microphone array
description: Speech, command, and situational awareness sensing for human-centric deployment.

name: Edge AI compute module
description: On-robot AI accelerator or SoC that runs perception, policy inference, and local planning within power and heat limits.

name: Real-time MCU and safety controller
description: Deterministic controller path for motor loops, E-stop, safe torque off, and health monitoring.

name: Motor-control network
description: Deterministic communication from central controller to many distributed motor drivers and sensor boards.

name: Time sync and sensor fusion
description: Timestamping, synchronization, calibration, and fusion of camera, IMU, encoder, force, and tactile streams.

name: Safety power isolation
description: Power isolation and protection architecture separating battery, high-current joints, compute, and safety logic.

name: Lightweight skeleton frame
description: Aluminum, magnesium, steel, polymer, or composite structure balancing weight, stiffness, impact, and manufacturability.

name: Torso enclosure and protective skin
description: Protective external surfaces that package compute, power, sensors, fans, and safe human contact.

name: Wiring harness and connectors
description: High-flex harness, connectors, strain relief, and service routing through moving limbs. It gates reliability because every joint adds bend cycles, EMI, connector retention, and service-routing failure modes.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: No reviewed public source prices high-flex humanoid harnessing, connector qualification, strain relief, EMI control, and service routing as a separate subsystem.

name: High-stiffness low-mass materials
description: Material set for limbs and torso where weight, stiffness, fatigue, cost, and manufacturability collide.

name: Foot contact structure
description: Foot sole, compliance, force sensing, tread, and replacement design for walking and balance.

name: Serviceable modular design
description: Architecture that lets fleet operators replace joints, hands, packs, sensors, and limbs without rebuilding the robot.

name: Whole-body control stack
description: Coordinated control of limbs, torso, hands, contacts, and center of mass.

name: Gait and balance policy
description: Walking, standing, stepping, push recovery, and uneven-floor policies.

name: Simulation-to-real training pipeline
description: Physics simulation, domain randomization, policy transfer, and hardware validation loop.

name: Contact force control
description: Force-position control for safe grasping, pushing, leaning, and foot-ground interaction.

name: Fall recovery and safe stop
description: Detection, controlled stopping, recovery, and service handoff for falls or unstable states.

name: Runtime safety monitor
description: Independent health and safety monitor for torque, temperature, battery, perception, and human proximity constraints.

name: Vision-language-action policy model
description: Embodied AI model that maps instructions and perception to action sequences.

name: Grasp planning policy
description: Planning and control for hand approach, grasp choice, grip adjustment, and release.

name: Teleoperation data collection
description: Human demonstration capture used to train manipulation and task policies.

name: Imitation and reinforcement-learning loop
description: Training loop for converting demonstrations, rewards, simulation, and fleet failures into policies.

name: Task planning and execution
description: Breaking user goals into perception, motion, grasp, tool, and verification steps.

name: Manipulation benchmark and evaluation
description: Task suite, metrics, data replay, and failure taxonomy for judging useful manipulation.

name: High-volume joint assembly
description: Assembly of motors, reducers, bearings, sensors, drives, harness, and housings at repeatable quality.

name: End-of-line calibration rig
description: Factory system for joint zeroing, torque calibration, sensor alignment, battery checks, and whole-body validation.

name: Battery pack end-of-line test
description: Pack electrical, thermal, balancing, safety, leakage, and charge/discharge validation before robot integration.

name: Whole-robot burn-in
description: Factory burn-in process for thermal soak, motion cycles, sensor drift, and early-life failures.

name: Reliability and MTBF tracking
description: Fleet telemetry and root-cause loop for joint, hand, battery, thermal, and sensor failures.

name: Functional safety and E-stop
description: Safety architecture for stop states, safe torque off, power isolation, human proximity, and incident logging.

name: Field service and spares loop
description: Service workflow for replacement joints, hands, batteries, sensors, calibration, and refurbishment. It gates TCO because a pilot fleet becomes expensive if failures require factory return or manual recalibration.

metrics.name: Cost disclosure
metrics.description: No reviewed public source prices humanoid field-service labor, spares pool, calibration workflow, refurbishment, and replacement-cycle cost.
